description: As many as 60,000 Washington State households statewide will qualify for Property Tax relief under a recent bill signed by Gov Ferguson in March 2026. A major portion of the property tax paid will be cut by half. You must be 61 years or older. The qualifying income threshold differs by county, but for Thurston County it will likely approach $98,000 for a married couple, $85,000 for Mason, and $108,000 for Kitsap. And equally important is the freeze on your taxed home value that would be enabled.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Vote 4 Jim Pierson
title: More Seniors Qualify for Property Tax Relief.
